name: Trustworthiness (Amanah)

definition_by_age.4: Taking good care of things you borrow.
definition_by_age.6: Amanah means being someone people can trust with their things or their secrets.
definition_by_age.8: Amanah is faithfully honoring the trust others place in you, in words, actions, and belongings.

learning_objective: Children can describe returning a borrowed item carefully.

recommended_default.note: Retrieval ranking (retrieval_ranking.md) starts from this combination and diversity-penalizes away from it on repeat use, per recommended_story_combinations.md.

qv_009.reasoning: Directly commands returning trusts (amanat) to their owners — names the exact concept.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Forgetting to pack something important fits natural-consequence learning.
